text:
jordan: Hi! New here. I'm testing an internal demo and streaming with my hosted key but hit 429s after a couple seconds. Should I be using a different key for demos?

devx: Welcome! Use the sandbox key for local demos. Hosted keys have stricter per-second/IP buckets.

jordan: Sandbox helped but the stream still drops occasionally. Any quick tips to avoid that during a live demo?

sophie: Try the dev-proxy with --keepalive so connections don't churn. Also reduce frequency of tiny reads.

ops-bot: [system] Reminder: requests mixing hosted and sandbox keys from same IP may trigger micro-throttles.

jordan: Ah that was it 94 I had CI running hosted tests in background. Turning that off fixed it. Thanks!

devx: If you need sustained demo throughput, file a short-lived hosted bump in #support with token/sec and duration and tag ops.

jordan: Will do. Appreciate the quick answers :thumbsup:
